title: Microsoft Purview: legacy Teams retention policies will stop covering Copilot interactions
summary: Hold: the briefing calls billing for other Copilots unpublished even though Microsoft's billing page documents a retention meter for non-Microsoft 365 AI interactions. The rollout, replacement policy and portal paths are supported; the PowerShell guidance also needs to acknowledge conflicting Microsoft references.

claims.claim: Some existing Teams-scoped retention policies currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.
claims.quote: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to convert legacy Teams-and-Copilot retention policies to Teams-only policies.
claims.quote: these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: January CY2027 is the roadmap target, with the change described in the summary as happening from mid-January 2027.
claims.quote: Worldwide: Beginning in mid-January 2027 (previously late October 2026) and expected to complete by end of January 2027 (previously mid-November)
claims.fix: Change the summary opening to 'Microsoft plans to begin treating Teams retention policies that also covered Microsoft 365 Copilot as Teams-only from mid-January 2027.' In What's changing, say 'expected to complete by end of January 2027' rather than presenting completion as certain.
